instruments.name: Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy – Ovarian
instruments.respondent_or_rater: self-reported; No proxy reporting will be permitted
instruments.scoring_or_range: The TOI score ranges from 0-100 and the FACT-O from 0-152. A higher score indicates a higher HRQoL.
instruments.purpose: assessment of the quality of life (QoL) of women with ovarian cancer

evidence.quote: The FACT-O (version 4) is a valid and reliable assessment of the quality of life (QoL) of women with ovarian cancer
The FACT-O will be self-reported through patient questionnaires according to the study plan. No proxy reporting will be permitted
The questionnaire covers a 7-day recall period.
The endpoint for HRQoL analysis will be the FACT-O Trial Outcome Index (TOI).
The TOI score ranges from 0-100 and the FACT-O from 0-152. A higher score indicates a higher HRQoL.
ovarian cancer subscale (11 items) of the FACT-O questionnaire version 4.

instruments.type: standardized instrument for measuring generic health status
instruments.scoring_or_range: five-level scale (5L) for each of five dimensions; visual analogue scale (VAS), ranging from 0 (worst imaginable health) to 100 (best imaginable health)

evidence.quote: EuroQol five dimensions questionnaire (EQ-5D-5L) is a standardized instrument for measuring generic health status.
Patients will self-rate their level of severity for each dimension using a five-level scale (5L).
The EQ-5D-5L questionnaire will be administered at the same time points as the FACT-O (5.3.1)
respondents select which statement best describes their health on that day from a possible five options of increasing levels of severity
respondents also assess their health today on a visual analogue scale (VAS), ranging from 0 (worst imaginable health) to 100 (best imaginable health).

notes: Single protocol document: Clinical Study Protocol D0816C00020 Version 3.0, 26 October 2018; no separate amendments in the PDF. Pages 2-3 have no text layer and were read from the page image: they are the Version History (v1.0 27 Jul 2017, v2.0 30 Aug 2017, v3.0 26 Oct 2018) and contain no abbreviation, panel, instrument or measurement content; the SoA (Tables 1-2, pages 40-44) is from Version 3.0. Rule 10: the lab-tests table (Table 3, page 47) runs its two columns together in the text layer (e.g. S/P-Sodium appears after the Urinalysis heading); page 47 was checked against the page image, which confirms Urinalysis (dipstick) = U-Hb/Erythrocytes/Blood, U-Protein/Albumin, U-Glucose and Clinical Chemistry includes S/P-Sodium, S/P-Urea or BUN and S/P-Total Protein. Conflicts: pregnancy test specimen is 'urine or serum' in Table 1 note c and inclusion criterion 10 but 'blood or urine' in Table 2 note e and Section 5.2.3.1 (both recorded). The retrospective gBRCA test is spelled 'Myriad BRCAnalysis CDx' (pages 12, 31) and the pre-study test 'Myriad BRACAnalysis®' (page 92); the HRD test is 'Myriad myChoice® HRD plus test' (page 12) and 'Myriad myChoice plus HRD test' (page 10). Section 5.2.2 says ECOG is performed at screening, baseline, each tumour assessment visit and the 30-day follow up, while Table 2 note a lists recording of ECOG status at safety visits. Lab of the Coagulation tests and of the ctDNA sample is not stated. Abbreviations on page 47 are those defined in the lab-tests table (the table words AST/ALT as 'transaminase', the list as 'aminotransferase'). The specimen prefixes B-, S/P-, U- in Table 3 are not defined in the document. Abbreviation-list tokens: the text layer of pages 19-22 separates terms and definitions into runs; pairing follows printed order. SoA activity tokens not in the abbreviation list: 'ctDNA' (defined in text, pages 11 and 50, as circulating tumour DNA), 'gBRCA' (list has only gBRCAm and BRCA1, BRCA2), 'AEs' (plural of AE), 'CA-125' in note e (CA defined only as Cancer antigen). SoA name 'Blood sample for restrospective gBRCA test' carries the source misspelling. Not described by the text beyond the SoA: Informed consent, IVRS/IWRS unique patient number obtained, Demographics, Medical and surgical history, Prior cancer therapies, History of blood transfusions, Inclusion/exclusion criteria, AEs, Concomitant medications, Olaparib dispensed/returned, Subsequent cancer therapy, Time to subsequent therapy and Survival (data collection, outside these categories). No ECG, height or other body measurements in the SoA. Pages 93-98 are redacted (CCI); pages 108-111 read only 'PPD'. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind.
